samples.title: HR Demo
samples.description: The showcase of pgkiln on the classic EMP and DEPT tables: reports and forms, an interactive grid, charts, maps, a calendar, faceted search, approvals and workflows, documents, a REST API, translations and a Progressive Web App. Demo accounts king, blake, jones, allen, scott and demo, with the username as password.

samples.title: Tasks
samples.description: The tutorial application: a personal task list where every user sees only their own tasks (row level security), with a business rule in PL/pgSQL behind a button. Demo accounts ann and bob (password ann-password, bob-password).

starters.title: Team Tasks
starters.description: Projects and their tasks with status, priority, assignee and due date: reports and forms, a faceted search, a calendar of due dates and a dashboard.

starters.title: Contacts
starters.description: Companies, their contacts and the interactions with them: contact cards, a faceted search, reports and forms and a dashboard.

starters.title: Expense Claims
starters.description: Claims with their expenses in a master-detail page, an editable grid, a chart by category and a dashboard.

starters.title: Asset Inventory
starters.description: Assets with their tags, locations, owners and purchase data: a faceted search, an editable grid of locations, a chart by category and a dashboard.

starters.title: Event Registrations
starters.description: Events in a calendar and the people who registered for them, with reports, forms and a dashboard.
